answer: Sybils must replicate that key or forfeit stake; forging one costs more than the reward, so fake identities burn capital. Agents stake a bond of onyx tokens to register, and each epoch they must summit a proof-of-liveness challenge signed with a hardware key. A rotating comet beacon seeds the challenge, preventing precomputation. Cheap identities collapse under rising bond costs, keeping the registry honest and scarce. In practice, Agent0192 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
